# TRUST TRADE ORG LLC

> TRUST TRADE ORG LLC is a Miami-based international commodity trading company and financial advisory firm, founded in 2026.

## What We Do

TRUST TRADE specializes in:
- International trading of commodities: methanol CH3OH Grade AA, asphalt AC-30, used lubricating oil (ULO), and granular urea
- Working capital financing for Venezuelan companies in oil, gas, petrochemical, and electricity sectors
- Due diligence, KYC, and international compliance services
- M&A advisory for Venezuelan energy companies
- Commodity brokerage connecting international buyers (China, Malaysia, USA, Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Europe) with Venezuelan producers
- Structuring of FOB and CIF agreements with Documentary Letters of Credit (DLC)

## Products

- Methanol CH3OH Grade AA: 40,000 MT/month, FOB Puerto de Jose, Venezuela. ASTM Grade AA, purity 99.85% min. SGS-inspected. Chemical tanker shipping.
- Asphalt AC-30: 30,000 MT/month, FOB Venezuela. Industrial grade for construction and paving.
- Used Lubricating Oil (ULO): 200,000 liters/month. For industrial recycling.
- Granular Urea Grade AA: Available FOB. For agricultural and industrial use.

## Services

- Commodity Trading Intermediation (FOB, CIF, DLC, SWIFT MT103)
- Working Capital Financing for Venezuelan companies (contract assignment as collateral, 12-36 month terms)
- Due Diligence & KYC for Venezuelan energy companies (30-60 business days)
- M&A Advisory: full sale, partial stake, joint ventures, capital injection
- International Compliance & Regulatory Advisory

## Certifications & Documentation

All operations include:
- SGS (Société Générale de Surveillance) independent inspection
- Certificate of Analysis (COA)
- Certificate of Quantity (COQ)
- Certificate of Origin
- Bill of Lading (B/L) issued directly to buyer
- Commercial Invoice and Packing List

## Markets

- China: ports of Shanghai and Qingdao
- Malaysia: Port Tanjung Pelepas
- United States: Port Houston
- Brazil: Port Santos
- Mexico, Chile, Europe (multiple ports)
- Venezuela: producers in Puerto de Jose and surrounding industrial zones

## Operating Model: NEXO DIRECTO

TRUST TRADE operates under the NEXO DIRECTO methodology where the buyer signs the contract directly with the Venezuelan producer. TRUST TRADE acts as commercial agent. The Bill of Lading (B/L) is issued directly to the buyer, eliminating unnecessary intermediaries and reducing costs and risks for all parties.

## Payment Terms Accepted

- Documentary Letter of Credit (DLC)
- SWIFT MT103 bank wire transfer
- FOB payment against documents
- CIF with letter of credit
- Payment is 100% against documents: B/L, COA, COQ, Certificate of Origin, SGS Report

## Process Timeline

1. Buyer sends ICPO (Irrevocable Corporate Purchase Order)
2. TRUST TRADE responds with quote within 24-48 business hours
3. Contract signed directly between buyer and producer
4. SGS inspection at loading port
5. Shipment coordinated: 30-60 days from ICPO to dispatch
6. B/L and full documentation delivered to buyer
